egg_hunt.name: Egg Hunt
egg_hunt.desc: Find hidden eggs around the village before time runs out!

bloom_dance.name: Bloom Dance
bloom_dance.desc: Dance under the blossoms. Everyone's friendship grows.

lantern_night.name: Tide Lantern Night
lantern_night.desc: Glowing Wildlings gather at the shore tonight.

summer_show.name: Summer Creature Show
summer_show.desc: Show off your lead Wildling to the judges!

harvest_fair.name: Harvest Fair
harvest_fair.desc: Display your best goods. The most valuable display wins!

spirits_eve.name: Spirit's Eve
spirits_eve.desc: Shade Wildlings roam the village. Some are very rare.

frost_festival.name: Frost Festival
frost_festival.desc: Warm drinks, snow sculptures, and good company.

battle_cup.name: Winter Battle Cup
battle_cup.desc: Battle three village champions in a row!

dex_milestones.text: 55 Wildlings befriended! You received the Starry Charm.
Wildling-dex complete! You are a true Hollowmere legend.

1.text: The Whisperwood Shrine glows! Tidecove's path is open, and you learned new recipes.

2.text: The Tidecove Shrine shines! Cinder Ridge is open, and the old greenhouse can now be repaired.

3.text: The Cinder Shrine blazes! Stonehollow is open. Quality Sprinklers and the Auto-Shipper are available.

4.text: The Stone Shrine rumbles! Galepeak is open. The Hilltop Terrace can be built.

5.text: The Gale Shrine sings! Sparkmarsh is open. The Wildling Spa can be built.

6.text: The Spark Shrine crackles! Frostmere is open. Gold Sprinklers can be crafted.

7.text: The Frost Shrine gleams! The path to Umbral Glade appears.

8.text: All eight shrines are restored! The valley is whole again. Seasonal legends now roam the land, and the Deep Hollow goes ever deeper.

backpacks.name: Farmer's Pack
backpacks.desc: Roomy, with a seed pocket that keeps planting quick.

backpacks.name: Explorer Pack
backpacks.desc: Light on the shoulders: you walk a little faster.

backpacks.name: Warden Pack
backpacks.desc: The biggest pack in the valley.

backpacks.name: Gardener's Pack
backpacks.desc: Seed slots and a trowel loop: crops grow a bit faster for you.

backpacks.name: Angler's Pack
backpacks.desc: A bait box and a lucky lure: fish bite sooner and rarer ones show up.

backpacks.name: Miner's Pack
backpacks.desc: A headlamp clip and ore straps: you see further underground and find more ore.

backpacks.name: High Roller's Pack
backpacks.desc: Gold-stitched velvet. A touch of luck rides along.

farm_levels.text: Flower Beds and Picket Fences are now sold at Bram's.
Plum saplings and Garden Gnomes are available!
Orange saplings and Birdbaths are available!
Pomegranate saplings and String Lights are available!
Snowpear saplings and Wildling Statues are available!
The Wishing Well is available at Bram's!
The Little Windmill is available at Bram's!
Farm level 15! Your farm is famous across the valley.
Farm level 20! A true master farmer.

story.title: New Roots
lines: So you're Hazel's grandchild! Welcome to Hollowmere.
The valley's eight shrines went dark the winter she passed. Since then the Wildlings keep to the woods.
Befriend a few of them first. Tall grass in the Meadow, south of the village, is a fine place to start.
story.hint: Befriend 3 Wildlings (walk into them in tall grass).

story.title: The Whispering Wood
lines: You have a way with them. Hazel did too.
Ivy keeps watch over the Whisperwood Shrine, north of the village. Battle her, then lay your hand on the stones.
story.hint: Beat Ivy in Whisperwood (north of the village), then wake its shrine.

story.title: Growing Season
lines: Tidecove's path is open now. But a Warden won't respect a farmer with an empty field.
Grow, ship, cook. Let the farm find its feet.
story.hint: Reach Farm Level 3 (harvest, ship, befriend and build).

story.title: Lanterns on the Water
lines: Marina has guarded Tidecove since she was a girl. She fights like the tide: patient, then all at once.
story.hint: Beat Marina in Tidecove (east of the village) and wake its shrine.

story.title: Salt and Line
lines: Old Ansel sent word from Gull Bay. The coast road past the harbor is clear again, east of the square.
Hazel used to fish off his pier every summer. Go and meet him. A farmer who can fish never goes hungry.
story.hint: Take the coast road (east of the village square) to Gull Bay and catch 5 fish.

story.title: Embers on the Ridge
lines: Cinder Ridge is too far to walk. Touch the wayshrine in the square: the old stones remember every road.
Ash runs hot. Bring Tide or Stone Wildlings.
story.hint: Travel by wayshrine to Cinder Ridge. Beat Ash and wake the shrine.

story.title: Kindred
lines: The shrines answer to more than strength. Hazel knew every name in this village.
Spend time with folk. Gifts, a kind word, a hand with the Village Board.

story.title: The Deep Stones
lines: Gideon of Stonehollow has never lost a battle he cared about. Make him care.
story.hint: Beat Gideon in Stonehollow and wake the shrine.

story.title: Above the Clouds
lines: Galepeak. Kai's Wildlings ride the wind. Spark and Stone will ground them.
story.hint: Beat Kai in Galepeak and wake the shrine.

story.title: Storm in the Marsh
lines: Volta lives for thunderstorms. Bring Stone, and an umbrella.
story.hint: Beat Volta in Sparkmarsh and wake the shrine.

story.title: The Frozen Mere
lines: Nils of Frostmere speaks rarely and battles even more rarely. Ember will warm him up.
story.hint: Beat Nils in Frostmere and wake the shrine.

story.title: The Twilight Glade
lines: The last shrine. Umbral Glade only appears to those the other seven trust.
Selene was Hazel's dearest friend. Go gently, and win.
story.hint: Beat Selene in Umbral Glade and wake the final shrine.

story.title: The Turning Seasons
lines: The valley breathes again. Can you feel it?
The old songs say four great Wildlings walk the seasons: one each in spring, summer, fall and winter. They come to the shrines of their home lands.
story.hint: Find a seasonal legend at its home shrine and befriend it.

story.title: Home
lines: Hazel would be proud. Hollowmere is whole, and it's yours.
The Deep Hollow under Stonehollow has no bottom, they say. And the other legends still roam...
story.hint: The valley is yours. Dig deeper in the Deep Hollow, chase the other legends, and fill the Wildling dex.
